title: SD PUC Order — Docket EL26-001: In the Matter of the Filing by Otter Tail Power Company for Approval of Tariff Revisions to Its Rates for Small Power Production and Cogeneration (Order Approving Tariff Revisions)
text:

ORDER APPROVING TARIFF 
REVISIONS 
EL26-001 
On January 30, 2026, the Commission received a filing from Otter Tail Power Company 
(Otter Tail) for approval of tariff revisions to its Small Power Producer Riders, Sections 12.01, 
12.02 and 12.03. Otter Tail proposes to update the energy payments, capacity payments, wind 
renewable energy credit, and My Renewable Energy Credit Rider, Section 14.14. These rates are 
for small qualifying facilities within the Otter Tail service area. Otter Tail requests an effective date 
of April 1, 2026. 
The revised tariff sheets are as follows: 
South Dakota P.U.C. Volume II-Electric Rate Schedule 
Section. 12.01 
Nineteenth Revised Sheet No. 1 
Section 12.02 
Nineteenth Revised Sheet No. 1 
Section 12.03 
Nineteenth Revised Sheet No. 1

Cancelling Eighteenth Revised Sheet No. 1 
Cancelling Eighteenth Revised Sheet No. 1 
Cancelling Eighteenth Revised Sheet No. 1 
Cancelling Eleventh Revised Sheet No. 2 
Cancelling First Revised Sheet No. 1 
On February 5, 2026, the Commission electronically transmitted notice of the filing and 
the intervention deadline of February 20, 2026, to interested entities and persons on the 
Commission's PUC Weekly Filings electronic listserv. No petitions to intervene or comments were 
filed. On March 3, 2026, Otter Tail filed responses to data requests. On March 19, 2026, 
Commission staff filed a Memorandum. 
The Commission has jurisdiction over this matter pursuant to 16 U.S. C. Chapter 12 § 
824a-3, 18 C.F.R. Part 292, SDCL Chapter 49-34A, specifically 49-34A-4, 49-34A-6, 49-34A-8, 
49-34A-10, 49-34A-12, 49-34A-93, and ARSD 20:10:13:02 through 20:10:13:28. 
At its regularly scheduled meeting on March 26, 2026, the Commission considered this 
matter. Commission staff recommended approval of the tariff revisions with an April 1, 2026, 
effective date. Finding the revisions to be just and reasonable, the Commission voted 
unanimously to approve the revisions, effective April 1, 2026. It is therefore 
ORDERED, that Otter Tail's request to revise its aforementioned tariff sheets is hereby 

granted, and the revisions are approved, effective for services rendered on and after April 1, 2026. 
Dated at Pierre, South Dakota, this 11~ day of March 2026.
